name: dsh-deepseek-usage
description: DSH web plugin: a DeepSeek account balance row in the sidebar footer (above Settings) plus a popover with the balance card, locally aggregated usage charts and a per-model cost table. Estimates usage from local DSH session logs; reads balance from the official /user/balance endpoint.

The sidebar.footer.action slot is declared by @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar (lib/client.js:296,399) - T5/T6 must verify slot availability at runtime instead of relying on this list, and must never depend on inject to guarantee a slot.
